title: GTA 5 vs GTA 6: 62¢ an Hour vs $79.99
caption:
GTA 5 Enhanced is $19.79 on Steam this week (56% off) and the story takes 32 hours (HowLongToBeat): 62¢ an hour. GTA 6 is $79.99, so you need 130 hours in it to match. Our own math.
How many hours will you put into GTA 6?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 26 Nov), HowLongToBeat, Rockstar Games
ig_first_line: 130 hours. That's how long you need in GTA 6 to make it as cheap as GTA 5 on sale this week.
